title: Nehemiah Builds Jerusalem's Wall
description: Nehemiah leads the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall despite strong opposition from enemies like Sanballat and Tobiah, completing the work in fifty-two days.

versions.reason: [major] references: The proposal covers Neh 1–6 and overlaps significantly with two existing stories: 'Nehemiah's Prayer and Calling' (1:1–2:10) and 'Opposition to Nehemiah's Building Work' (4:1–17). These should be merged into one cohesive story about the rebuilding.; [major] slug: The existing story 'Nehemiah's Prayer and Calling' has an incorrect slug 'elia-blir-tatt-bort', but that is not something we can fix here—just note it.
